macro_bullets: Oil jumped as Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport and vows to block more Hormuz routes drove Mideast supply fears and record wartime shipping disruption.
Fed's Waller said more rate hikes are needed, keeping Treasury yields elevated with the 30-year mortgage rate at a near three-year high.
Samsung forecast a record ~$80 billion Q3 profit on the AI boom, though preliminary results disappointed enough to cool the memory trade.
The IEA said it will accelerate oil reserve releases, with 100 million barrels still to come.
Germany's government raised its 2026 and 2027 growth forecasts.
internals_narrative: Memory (+1.4%) and Pharma (+0.8%) led as MU jumped +4.1% and LLY, AMGN, INTU rose, while rate-sensitive and cyclical groups lagged—Robotics & Hardware fell -5.3% (OUST -7.2%), Industrials -1.9% and Materials -1.5%, with CAT -5.7%, SLB -4.1% and other energy-services names among the biggest losers.

ticker_notes.MU: Memory names rallied even as reports flagged the trade cooling after Samsung's preliminary results disappointed.
ticker_notes.LLY: Cantor raised price targets on LLY alongside other pharma behemoths while flagging growth concerns at Pfizer.
ticker_notes.AMGN: Analysts weighed what it would take to move Amgen stock higher.
ticker_notes.INTU: Intuit expanded its AI accountant suite, reviving the undervaluation debate.
ticker_notes.ISRG: Barclays launched bullish coverage of Intuitive Surgical amid rising surgical-robotics rivalry.
ticker_notes.STZ: Constellation's Q2 earnings call highlighted improving demand and outlook.
ticker_notes.OUST: Ouster slid on scrutiny of whether its drone-lidar partnerships are reshaping its autonomy strategy.
ticker_notes.IREN: IREN fell ~7% as financing-heavy data-center names sold off and SemiAnalysis flagged reliability issues.
ticker_notes.CAT: Caterpillar fell nearly 6% as Treasury yields hit 24-year highs, pressuring gas-compression demand.
ticker_notes.RKLB: Rocket Lab dropped ~4% in a broad space-stock selloff led by AST SpaceMobile.
ticker_notes.SLB: SLB signed a 15-year DrillPlan deal with TotalEnergies and expanded its digital alliance with Chevron.
ticker_notes.USAR: Fresh attention turned to USA Rare Earth amid the rare-earths trade.
ticker_notes.CHTR: Charter set a webcast to discuss third-quarter 2026 results.
ticker_notes.AZO: AutoZone's fair value edged lower after a softer Q4 and DIY pressure.
ticker_notes.AIG: Analysts cut price targets on AIG, with Mizuho and Morgan Stanley trimming estimates.
ticker_notes.APD: Air Products will build Malaysia's first LNG-based air separation unit for a PETRONAS Gas Berhad-led JV.
ticker_notes.AMT: Investors previewed American Tower's upcoming Q3 2026 earnings.
ticker_notes.AMD: Meta's Muse gave AMD and Intel investors a reason to cheer.
ticker_notes.AEP: Coverage questioned whether AEP's dividend can survive the data-center buildout.
